dedupe_keys.name: eries database for validation of urban ventilation and pollution dispersion models

description: ERIES publishes pollutant-concentration measurements for a central Sofia urban geometry represented in an Eindhoven wind tunnel. The target region has an approximate diameter of 0.91 kilometres. A 1:350 model was measured at seventy-six locations for two point-source positions. The provider describes a neutral ethylene tracer release and one prevailing wind direction. Coverage: Temporal coverage is not stated in the reviewed source. Geographic extent follows the named site or scope; unstated extents and sampling intervals remain unknown. Access: public 4TU.ResearchData metadata links describe the release. Formats: XLSX, PDF, STEP, JPEG images, Matlab scripts and plain text. Licence: CC-BY-4.0. Cost and present file access are unverified. Caveats: Neutral releases omit buoyancy effects. The experiment does not establish all weather conditions or urban configurations. Simulation uses follow the source-defined purpose above. Related resources are retained in the same native collection with their distinct identities.
